name: Sack of Murloc Heads
summary: Along the Hillsbrad beaches, a gruesome sack of Murloc Heads is gathered as proof of military action against local shore pests. Lieutenant Farren Orinelle hands the bundle to passing adventurers for delivery to Marshal Redpath in Southshore.

sections.title: Bureaucracy and Coastal Pests
sections.body: Southshore faces constant attacks from Syndicate outlaws, Forsaken skirmishers, and wild murlocs along the coast. Local officers must show town leaders that coastal threats are being culled to secure funding and favor. Lieutenant Farren Orinelle collects severed heads as proof, but finds the cargo distasteful. His squeamishness leads him to hand the sack to travelers instead of bringing the grisly evidence to Marshal Redpath himself.

faq.q: What is the Sack of Murloc Heads?
faq.answer: The Sack of Murloc Heads is a burlap sack of severed murloc heads gathered from Hillsbrad's western beaches. It gives Southshore's garrison commander physical proof of efforts to pacify the coast.

faq.q: Why won't Lieutenant Farren deliver it himself?
aliases: why farren makes you carry it
faq.answer: Lieutenant Farren Orinelle finds carrying a foul-smelling bag of decaying murloc heads revolting. He hands the unpleasant delivery across Southshore to an obliging adventurer.
Marshal Redpath receives the sack. He commands Southshore's defenses, assesses the town's security, and demands proof of defensive efforts.

faq.q: Why does Southshore require murloc heads as proof?
faq.answer: Southshore requires murloc heads as proof because murlocs constantly raid the coast and threaten the harbor. Officers must verify that patrols maintain perimeter security, and tangible trophies help ensure soldiers do not claim credit for idle watches.

angles.text: As an Alliance member, you see the frayed logistics and unglamorous daily burdens Southshore's defenders bear as they hold the northern Alliance enclave together.
